definitions.full: H1264. berom בְּרֹמִים noun [masculine] variegated cloth (Arabic rope (or fabric) of two strands or colours ; compare Assyrian birmu , a kind of clothing COT Gloss , burmu , iris , Zim BP 82 ; on bur¥mu compare Jen Kosmol. 6 ff. ) בְּרֹמִים וּבְגִנְזֵי Ezek 27:24 . בַּרְנֵעַ compare ב ׳קדשׁ .
